# MarsWalk Atlas – Project Summary

MarsWalk Atlas is an interactive Mars exploration and mission-planning web application designed to help users explore the Martian surface and plan simulated Extravehicular Activities (EVAs). The project integrates NASA-based scientific data and interactive mapping technologies to provide an informative Mars exploration experience.

The application features real Mars maps using NASA/JPL Mars Trek data, including MOLA elevation maps and Viking colour imagery. Users can select different Mars exploration sites, mark locations on the interactive map, create walking routes, and calculate route distances. It also includes a Mars clock that displays local solar time, sunrise and sunset timings, Martian seasons, dust storm season, and Mars Sol Date.

The EVA route analysis feature evaluates walking distance, estimated mission duration, return time, science stops, sunset safety margins, and illustrative radiation-dose estimates based on user-defined walking speed and mission limits. Additionally, users can explore NASA rover photographs from Perseverance and Curiosity and view rover traverse information.

The project uses HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, Express.js, and Leaflet.js, with NASA APIs for external data integration.

**Overall, MarsWalk Atlas demonstrates the practical application of web development, API integration, interactive mapping, and scientific data visualization to create an engaging Mars exploration planning platform.**
